history.overview: The Discord Reactor powers Muramite industrial operations and stabilizes raw Discord energy.

timeline.name: Fissure Discovery
timeline.description: Muramite scouts discovered a massive Discord fissure beneath the industrial territories.

timeline.name: Reactor Construction
timeline.description: Dragorn slaves built the containment pylons and reactor housing.

timeline.name: Core Activation
timeline.description: Inquisitors activated the reactor core, stabilizing raw Discord energy.

timeline.name: Industrial Integration
timeline.description: The reactor was linked to foundries, refineries, and siege fabrication lines.
